resources.string: Send finger touches as a touchscreen

USB: enable USB tethering (Settings → Connections → Mobile Hotspot and Tethering), plug into the computer, then tap Scan. Or, with USB debugging on, run adb reverse tcp:7741 tcp:7741 on the computer and this uses 127.0.0.1.
Make sure the tablet and computer are on the same Wi-Fi, then tap Scan.
Enter the computer IP address (run ip -4 addr on it) and port 7741.
